input_usuario: Liste os 5 maiores credores por valor pago em 2025.
query_referencia: SELECT nom_credor, SUM(CAST(vlr_pag_fonte AS DECIMAL)) AS total FROM despesa_pagamento WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 AND COALESCE(nom_credor, '') NOT ILIKE '%NAO INFORMADO%' AND num_doc_credor NOT IN ('-1', '0') GROUP BY nom_credor ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;
query_gerada: SELECT nom_credor, SUM(CAST(vlr_pag_fonte AS DECIMAL)) AS total_pago FROM despesa_pagamento WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 AND COALESCE(nom_credor, '') NOT ILIKE '%NAO INFORMADO%' AND COALESCE(num_doc_credor, '') NOT IN ('-1', '0') GROUP BY nom_credor ORDER BY total_pago DESC LIMIT 5;
